critical_code_review_comments: MODVisitCalendar.BookingDetails defaults to open when a booking is present, so the 'toggle' behaves as a collapse rather than expand on first click; consider defaulting to closed to match the 'expandable' wording in requirements. Not a blocker — all data still visible by default.

No public route to inspect svc_sicon_outbox from the API surface; a lightweight master-admin GET /api/master-admin/sicon/outbox listing (or existing worker admin) would help future regression tests validate ContractID/ResourceID without direct DB access.
